title: ‘Filipiñana’ actress Jorrybell Agoto’s family appeals for financial help amid critical condition
summary: Jorrybell Agoto’s family is seeking financial assistance for the actress’s treatment after her condition worsened due to lymphoma, prompting her return to the Critical Care Unit.
